Named soil and leaf-litter animals including ants, earthworms, beetles, and millipedes.
Practised identifying animals found in soil and leaf litter across three attempts.

end.parentNote: Asha practised naming small animals found in soil and leaf litter, using examples and repeated recall. Pihu named several creatures and connected ants and earthworms with observations. They mixed up whether woodlice are insects; this was not clearly corrected during the lesson. At home, look at a handful of dry leaves or soil together and take turns naming the creatures that may live there.
